verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an official UCP CLI, installed with `npm install -g @shopify/ucp-cli`. It has structured commands for catalog search, carts, checkouts, buyer handoff and order tracking, a five-minute quickstart, a reusable local profile, `--input-schema` introspection, and an AI Toolkit skill that maps natural-language requests to CLI commands. A hands-on probe used the CLI with a self-generated profile to search the live catalog and create a real cart. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of the checkout, handoff and order commands beyond cart creation, and independent community corroboration.
